title: Haryana farmer leaders unite to protest against sugarcane prices

ai.summary: Haryana farmer leaders formed a unified front to protest against sugarcane prices, aiming to close sugar mills and demand ₹600 per quintal.

facts.claim: Haryana farmer leaders formed a unified front
facts.quote: This is the first time since the 2020-21 agitation against the farm laws that farmer leaders from different ideologies met jointly at Neem Sahib Gurudwara, Kaithal to decide on a possible unity
the gathering decided to fight the ongoing movement demanding the sugarcane price of ₹600 per quintal
the gathering decided to fight the ongoing movement demanding the sugarcane price of ₹600 per quintal

facts.claim: Plan to stop harvesting and lock mills
facts.quote: farmers have so far decided to stage protests at 14 sugar mills across the state, planning also to stop harvesting and lock the mills

ai.background_note: Haryana farmers formed a unified coalition to protest against sugarcane prices, following a government hike to ₹430 per quintal, with demands for ₹600 per quintal.
